faq.title: Seedance 2.5 Questions
faq.description: Release, early access, capability, and current generator information.

items.question: Is Seedance 2.5 available on this site now?
items.answer: No. ByteDance announced Seedance 2.5 on June 23, 2026, and it remains in enterprise preview. BytePlus currently lists broader availability as "Coming soon." This site's generator continues to use the available Seedance 2.0 models until official Seedance 2.5 access is supported.

items.question: What can I generate today?
items.answer: The current generator supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video workflows through the models configured by the site administrator. Seedance 2.0 options support common aspect ratios, durations, and resolutions up to 1080p where available.

items.question: What is new in Seedance 2.5?
items.answer: The announcement focuses on longer video generation, richer multimodal reference inputs, stronger visual consistency, and more controllable cinematic storytelling. Final limits and API details should be confirmed from official documentation after public release.

items.question: Does Seedance 2.5 support 30-second video?
items.answer: Up to 30-second generation is part of the announced Seedance 2.5 capability set. It is not currently available through this site's Seedance 2.0 generator.

items.question: How are generation credits calculated?
items.answer: Credit cost depends on the selected model, generation mode, duration, and resolution. The generator shows the estimated cost before you submit a task.

items.question: Can generated videos be used commercially?
items.answer: Commercial use depends on your plan, the selected provider's model terms, and applicable law. Review the Terms of Service and the provider policy before publishing paid or client work.
